entries.reason: the port has no MIDI-CI transport: discoverWithHandler does nothing and says so once in the log (charon_ci_inert, MIDICI14.m). On the measured host macOS refuses its own MIDI-CI client (-10844) and never calls the handler (oracle/micicapability-macos.txt), so the no-op is that answer; a machine with a MIDI-CI device is not measured.
entries.effect: the discovery handler is never called, and no device is listed.

entries.reason: the port has no MIDI-CI transport: start, notifyProfile and sendProfile do nothing and answer NO, each saying so once in the log (charon_ci_inert, MIDICI14.m). The responder is not made on the measured host (oracle/micicapability-macos.txt).
entries.effect: a responder never starts, notifies or sends a profile.
